Respondents Writ appeal filed under Clause 15 of the Letters Patent

1

Act, to set aside the order dated 10.07.2025 in Review Application No.162 of 2025 in WP.No.36434
of 2024 as illegal, arbitrary and contrary to law and consequently direct the respondent No.1 to 5 to
take action to cancel the Power of Attorney Deed dated 02.08.1991 registered as Document
No.1239/Book 4/1991, registered before sub Registrar, Anna Nagar, Sale Deed dated 30.10.2009
registered as Document No.3321 of 2009, registered before Sub-Registrar, Villivakkam as they are
fraudulent document and consequently direct the 5 th respondent to execute the sale deed in respect
of Plot No.1294, 72 nd Street, Korattur, Chennai 600 080, Tamil Nadu Housing Board Korattur
Scheme, comprised in Survey No.816/2B, Korattur Village, Ambattur Tk, now Chennai Dt to and in
favour of the appellants and further direct the 6 th respondent to permit the appellants to withdraw
compensation of Rs.26,55,199/- deposited towards the acquisition of part of Plot No.1294 along
with the accrued interest, __________ Page3 of 6 https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis ( Uploaded
on: 09/02/2026 01:23:27 pm ) award costs and render justice.
For Appellants : Mr.Balan Haridas For Respondents : Mr.P.Harish, Government Advocate [RR1 to 4 & 6] Judgment (Judgment of the Court was delivered by R.Suresh Kumar J.)
This intra-court appeal in fact has been filed against the order passed in Rev.Applw.No.162 of 2025 dated 10.07.2025.

The said review application was filed against the order passed in W.P.No.36434 of 2024 dated 22.01.2025.
2.

It is brought to our notice by Mr.Balan Haridas, learned counsel appearing for the appellants that as against the order passed in W.P.No.36434 of 2024 dated 22.01.2025, an appeal has been filed,
which is at the S.R. stage in W.A.Sr.No.157299 of 2025, since there is CMP for condoning the delay in C.M.P.No.28711 of 2025 is pending.
3.

In view of the said factual position, where the present appellants have already chosen to file an appeal against the main order i.e., order passed in W.P.No.36434 of 2024 dated 22.01.2025 and the said appeal if it is decided in one way or other, nothing would survive in the present appeal as it is only an offshoot of the review application.
_ _ Page4 of 6 https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis ( Uploaded on: 09/02/2026 01:23:27 pm )

4. In that view of the matter, while dismissing this writ appeal for the aforesaid reason, liberty is given to the appellants to pursue their writ appeal in W.A.Sr.No.157299 of 2025 and if that appeal is taken up and decided, the order to be passed in the said appeal will cover the issue raised in this appeal also.
Accordingly, this writ appeal is dismissed.
No costs.
